lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Concept model B: systems from contexts

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Compare these two examples. Find the step where they stop being the same.

items.prompt: Plan A charges a $10 flat fee plus $3 per month. Plan B charges a $4 flat fee plus $5 per month. After how many months do the two plans cost the same, and what is that cost?

steps: Set the two cost expressions equal: 10 + 3x = 4 + 5x.
Subtract 3x and 4 from both sides: 6 = 2x, so x = 3.
Substitute x = 3 into either plan to get a cost of 19, so the plans cost the same after 3 months at $19.

items.prompt: Plan A charges a $10 flat fee plus $3 per month. Plan B charges a $4 flat fee plus $5 per month. The solution to the system is (3, 19). What does this solution represent?

steps: The x-coordinate, 3, is the number of months in the solution.
The y-coordinate, 19, is the shared cost in dollars at that point.
Together, (3, 19) means both plans cost $19 after 3 months.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: System: y = x + 4 and y = -3x + 24. Does the point (6, 10) satisfy both equations, fail one, or fail both?
Plan A charges a $33 flat fee plus $9 per visit. Plan B charges a $66 flat fee plus $6 per visit. The solution to the system is (11, 132). What does the y-coordinate of the solution represent?
choices: The difference in cost between the two plans.
The number of visits after which the two plans cost the same.
The rate Plan B charges per visit.
The shared cost, in dollars, when the two plans are equal.

items.prompt: System: y = 5x + 15 and y = 6x + 19. Which point (x, y) satisfies both equations?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Solve the system: y = -2x - 6 and y = -x + 1. What is the intersection point (x, y)?
Relationship A: x: 2, 3, 4, 5 y: 1, -4, -9, -14. Relationship B: x: 2, 3, 4, 5 y: 1, 2, 3, 4. At which x-value do the two relationships have the same y-value?
Solve the system: y = -2x + 37 and y = 6x - 67. In which quadrant does the intersection point lie, or does it lie on an axis?

Solve the system:
y = 5x + 86
6x + 10y = 76
Use substitution to find the solution (x, y).
